content: function  WdgM_CheckpointReached  [SWS_CP_SYS_00021]   Std_ReturnType WdgM_CheckpointReached(WdgM_SupervisedEntityIdType SEID, WdgM_CheckpointIdType CPID); Notifies the WdgM that a supervised execution checkpoint has been reached, updating Alive counters, Deadline timers, and Logical execution graph transitions.
